decisions.reason: This drain housing still builds on the firm's core drainage engineering and system compatibility, so despite limited recent visibility the firm has enough related knowledge to refine and retain it.
A floor-level shower drainage system sits at the heart of the firm's target market and strategic direction, making continued support and incremental improvement highly likely.
As a design-led shower drainage flagship, it remains closely aligned with the firm's strongest technical and commercial learning base and is therefore very unlikely to be withdrawn.
The shower element with integrated slope complements the firm's installation and waterproofing expertise, giving the firm strong absorptive capacity to keep improving and selling it.
Although more niche than the main bathroom design lines, this backflow-protected basement drain still fits the firm's drainage problem-solving capabilities and is worth keeping in the portfolio.
The air-admittance valve is the most peripheral to the firm's main shower and floor-drainage knowledge base, so weaker strategic fit and lower learning synergies make withdrawal the likelier choice.
